```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())
```

```{r}
#| label: load-packages

source(here::here("0-config.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "0-functions.R"))

refit_models_flag <- TRUE # Set to TRUE to refit models, which can take a long time. Set to FALSE to load previously fitted models.
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data

# Load grappe-level mortality data
df_all <- readRDS(here("data","grappe_mortality_data.rds"))

```

```{r}
#| label: prep data

# Project coordinates to UTM so distances are in meters, not degrees

df_proj <- df_all %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = global_crs) %>%
  st_transform(crs = proj_crs) %>% # UTM zone 31N, for Niger
  mutate(lon = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,1],
         lat = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,2])

```

```{r}
#| label: fit model

if (refit_models_flag) {

tic("Fitting nested model with Matern correlation and random effects for CSI and district")
  fit_nested <- spaMM::fitme(n_deaths_1to59 ~ 
                               1 + 
                               Matern(1|lat + lon) +
                               (1 | district:csi) +
                               (1 | district) +
                             offset(log(pt_year_1to59)),
                           data = df_proj,
                           family = poisson(link = "log"),
                           control.HLfit=list(NbThreads=max(avail_thr, 1L))
                           )
toc()

saveRDS(fit_nested, here("data", "var_partition_model.rds"))
} else {
fit_nested <- readRDS(here("data", "var_partition_model.rds"))
}

summary(fit_nested)

```

```{r}
#| label: variance-components

# extract the variance components from the model
varcomps <- get_ranPars(fit_nested)
varcomps$lambda

# summarize the proportion of the variance in mortality
# explained by each random effect
# (fine-scale spatial correlation, CSI within district, district)
prop_var <- varcomps$lambda / sum(varcomps$lambda)
round(prop_var,3)

```

The variance partitioning results suggest that approximately `r round(prop_var[1],3)*100`% of the variance in mortality is explained by fine-scale spatial correlation, `r round(prop_var[2],3)*100`% is explained by differences between CSIs within districts, and `r round(prop_var[3],3)*100`% is explained by differences between districts.

Estimating the proportion of variance lost due to aggregation to the CSI level


```{r}
#| label: fit grappe and csi models

if(refit_models_flag){
  tic("Fitting grappe-level model with Matern correlation and random effects for CSI and district")
fit_grappe <- fitme(
  n_deaths_1to59 ~ 1 + isTreated_child + lon + lat +
    Matern(1 | lon + lat) +
    (1 | district) +
    (1 | district:csi) +
  offset(log(pt_year_1to59)),
  family = negbin(),  # important
  data = df_proj,
  control.HLfit=list(NbThreads=max(avail_thr, 1L))
)
toc()
saveRDS(fit_grappe, here("data", "var_part_grappe_model.rds"))
} else {
fit_grappe <- readRDS(here("data", "var_part_grappe_model.rds"))
}

if(refit_models_flag){
  tic("Fitting CSI-level model with Matern correlation and random effects for district")
fit_csi <- fitme(
  n_deaths_1to59 ~ 1 + 
    lon + lat +
    Matern(1 | lon + lat) +
    (1 | district) +
  offset(log(pt_year_1to59)),
  family = negbin(),  # important
  data = df_proj %>%
    group_by(district, csi) %>%
    summarise(n_deaths_1to59 = sum(n_deaths_1to59),
              pt_year_1to59 = sum(pt_year_1to59),
              lon = mean(lon),
              lat = mean(lat)) %>%
    ungroup(),
  control.HLfit=list(NbThreads=max(avail_thr, 1L))
)
toc()
saveRDS(fit_csi, here("data", "var_part_csi_model.rds"))
} else {
fit_csi <- readRDS(here("data", "var_part_csi_model.rds"))
}

```
